independent_reference.source: Pena, B. & Perez-Garcia, C. (2001), Stability of Turing patterns in the Brusselator model, Phys. Rev. E 64, 056213, section II: the uniform state (A, B/A) is Turing-unstable for B > B_c = (1 + A eta)^2 with eta = sqrt(Du/Dv), first at the critical wavenumber k_c^2 = A / sqrt(Du Dv). Here A = 4.5, Du = 1, Dv = 10: B_c = (1 + 4.5 sqrt(0.1))^2, q_c^2 = 4.5 / sqrt(10).

Murray, J. D. (2003), Mathematical Biology II: Spatial Models and Biomedical Applications, 3rd ed., Springer, section 2.3: for a two-species system with Jacobian (f_u, f_v; g_u, g_v) and diffusivities (Du, Dv), the Turing bifurcation occurs when (Dv f_u + Du g_v)^2 = 4 Du Dv det J, at the critical wavenumber k_c^2 = sqrt(det J / (Du Dv)). Applied to the Brusselator Jacobian (B - 1, A^2; -B, -A^2) with A = 2, Du = 1, Dv = 10 at its onset B. Hand-derivation: tools/testkit/golden/derivations/brusselator-turing.md section 3.

Prigogine, I. & Lefever, R. (1968), Symmetry breaking instabilities in dissipative systems. II, J. Chem. Phys. 48, 1695: the trimolecular model's uniform state loses stability to homogeneous oscillations (a limit cycle) when B > 1 + A^2. At B = 1 + A^2 the q = 0 Jacobian has trace B - 1 - A^2 = 0 and positive determinant A^2, so Re sigma(0) = 0. Here A = 4.5: B_H = 21.25.
